name: extension-downloads
title: DuckDB Extension Dashboard
purpose: How are DuckDB's community extensions being adopted, week by week?

dashboards.question: Is the extension ecosystem growing, and what's hot?
How is one contributor doing versus the whole ecosystem?
Who made this, and how current is the data?

input.kind: data root: downloads.parquet (one row per ISO week and extension: year, week, week_start, extension, downloads, last_update, provisional) and meta.json, both written by scripts/fetch.sh from DuckDB's public download metrics

variables.extension: the extension shown on extension.sql (dropdown, ?v.extension=<name>; a path variable on the locked server)
variables.contributor: contributor.sql: the contributor shown (dropdown, ?v.contributor=<name>, links from contributors.sql; default DataZooDE); on rankings.sql the same variable filters the table (default (all)). Not a path variable: a contributor or group name need not be a plain name
